versions.content: The same N Pdu may only be referenced by more than one NSdu (RxNSdu or TxNSdu, via CanTpRxNPdu, CanTpTxFcNPdu, CanTpTxNPdu, or CanTpRxFcNPdu), when either the NSdu has addressing format extended or mixed (29 or 11 bit), or when the NPdu has MetaData.
